# Green (Sirun) Wang

> UC Berkeley undergraduate studying political economy and applied mathematics.

I am an undergraduate at UC Berkeley studying political economy and applied mathematics. I am interested in how institutions and information shape what people value and believe, particularly how preferences and beliefs develop together in different institutional settings.

Two PhD-level course papers are in topic development; topics and mentors are not yet determined and abstracts are coming soon. Two earlier course projects have summaries available. None is listed as a publication. Notes contains open questions. Content updated 2026-09-07; this is an edition date.
